text: The meeting the whole project built toward: Finance, Marketing, and Product looking at the same dashboard for the first time -- and the new numbers don't match any of their old ones.

Two separate bridges, not one blurry story: Marketing's snapshot missed members who paused mid-month; Finance's count used a billing rule instead of a status one; Finance's revenue number had the fanout bug on top of that.
One real member, projected live -- active most of September, paused on the 28th. A month-end snapshot would have missed them. A concrete row earns more trust than any slide of totals.
Open with the numbers, not an apology. Name the revenue bug plainly, already fixed and tested. Close with written agreement: both marts, every team, one source from here on.
The numbers are adopted. Next: writing it all down so it survives without anyone standing in the room to explain it.
